qa_pairs.question: What steps should a user take if AnsysEDT crashes and won't restart on an Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: If AnsysEDT crashes and won't restart, a user should first run `pkill -9 -u $USER -f "ansys*|mono|mwrpcss|apip-standalone-service"`. Following this, they should remove the local configuration by running `rm -rf ~/.mw`, which will cause AnsysEDT to re-run its first-time configuration on startup.

qa_pairs.question: How can a researcher configure their license file to use the SHARCNET Ansys license for AnsysEDT modules on any Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer:
A researcher can use the SHARCNET Ansys license for AnsysEDT modules on any Alliance cluster by configuring their `ansys.lic` file. This is done by creating or modifying `~/.licenses/ansys.lic` to include the lines:
`setenv("ANSYSLMD_LICENSE_FILE", "1055@license3.sharcnet.ca")`
`setenv("ANSYSLI_SERVERS", "2325@license3.sharcnet.ca")`
